articles.title: ‘Get me out’: Traders dump software stocks as AI fears erupt
articles.mainIdea: ‘Get me out’: Traders dump software stocks as AI fears erupt
articles.summary: Bloomberg: ‘Get me out’: Traders dump software stocks as AI fears erupt. “We call it the ‘SaaSpocalypse,’ an apocalypse for software-as-a-service stocks,” said Jeffrey Favuzza, who works on the equity trading desk at Jefferies. Selling pressure was evident across the sector with London Stock Exchange Group Plc, which has a large data analytics business, falling 13%, while Thomson Reuters Corp. plunged 16%. CS Disco Inc. sank 12%, and Legalzoom.com Inc. plummeted 20%. Related tickers mentioned: ANTH.PVT, LAW, LZ.
